audit.why: Favoured lane (52.1% over 2806 games): Brand is immobile with Flash as his only escape; Sylas wins every stage per packet chart and both layers agree (Sylas x7). No chart edits needed.
Spikes correctly identified: level 3 all-in, level 6 (raw all-in or Hijacked Pyroclasm), first item execute threat; late stays Sylas since Brand never gains mobility.

audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.cooldowns carried no numbers; dos/donts bullets were tradeGood/tradeBad pasted verbatim; the Sear-only-stuns-while-ablaze mechanic was stated but never tied to his actual cooldown windows.
audit.why: Brand Q is 8/7.5/7/6.5/6 and only stuns an ablaze target; W 10s at 900 range, E 13s, R 100/90/80 vs Hijack 80/55/30. His post-rotation window is the lane's brawl timer.
audit.corrected: Numbers written into breakdown.cooldowns; bleed bullets replaced with post-combo window and Blaze-detonation facts.

edits.before: - Brand Sear (Stun): matchup-defining — Q only stuns when you are ablaze — after eating W or E, the stun line is the dodge that matters. Count it out loud if you must. - Your E Abscond (shield-dash) has one job: the moment it all goes wrong. - The R has one too: the moment it all goes right.
edits.after: - Brand Sear (Q): 8s early, 6s max — it only stuns while you are ablaze, so after eating W or E it is the dodge that matters. - Pillar of Flame is 10s and Conflagration 13s: post-rotation he sits 8+ seconds unarmed — that is your brawl window. - Pyroclasm is 100s; Hijack returns in 80.

edits.before: E-shield in, E2-chain, Q-W with whirls between, heal out — the full brawl string he answered with one rotation and regret.
edits.after: His full rotation leaves Q at 8s and E at 13s — once it is spent, Abduct in and run the whole string before Sear comes back up.

edits.before: Chaining into a loaded CC with W down — Sylas without the heal is a mage who chose melee for the aesthetic.
edits.after: Three Blaze stacks detonate on you at half HP — with Kingslayer's heal down, his DoT alone finishes what the stun started.

edits.before: Brand wins by landing Sear (Stun), denying your pattern, and owning the spacing war until your tempo starves.
edits.after: Brand wins by stacking Blaze from 900 range, landing the ablaze Sear stun, and chunking you before you ever reach him.

edits.before: Ahead, monopolize: brawl Brand off every contact, steal the map's best button on cooldown, and flank fights with their own game plan.
edits.after: Ahead, bully the immobile mage: Brand's only escape is Flash, so every shoved wave is a dive and every down Sear is a free kill.

edits.before: You are whatever the enemy drafted best: steal the fight-flipper, flank with chains, and let W make their focus-fire a rounding error.
edits.after: Late his AoE shreds teams but never you alone: steal Pyroclasm, flank the backline, and Abduct the bomb-carrier out of his stacks.

notes: Kit flag misfire: Brand W carries a 'terrain' flag but Pillar of Flame creates no terrain per Riot's own description — trusted the description, wrote nothing about terrain. Level chart consistent across both layers (Sylas x7), matches packet — untouched.
